definition: Offer a usable welcome, ask/listen to the actual request and confirm required versus flexible conditions and wanted service. Agree only available permitted actions, keep preferences within the current permitted record purpose and update the guest accurately through changes. Personalised service does not require unwanted attention or guessed needs.
input_specification: A supervised hotel role-play supplies guests with their own preferences, a current personalised-service menu, actual available arrangements, permitted records/contact scope and service/referral authority. One guest wants a quiet text exchange, another declines assistance and a third corrects a stated preference. No lifestyle, ability or consent is inferred from appearance or a previous stay.

practice_exercise.label: 1. Count and find a shortfall
practice_exercise.goal: Keep the item unit consistent, count a collection and compare it with a target.

cards.title: Counter tray
cards.text: Each ● is one item. Three rows contain four items each. The target tray must contain 15 items.

questions.prompt: How many items are in the counter tray?
steps: Count four in each of three rows: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 items.
Check by moving one counter for each item or by calculating 3 × 4.

questions.prompt: How many more items are needed to reach 15?
steps: Compare the target of 15 with the counted 12.

mistakes.feedback: You combined the current and target amounts. Find the difference between them.

questions.prompt: New target: the tray still contains 12 items, but now needs 17. How many more items are needed?
steps: Keep the current collection at 12 and change the target to 17.

practice_exercise.input: A way to distinguish one item from another; a reader/partner may read the target. Counting objects, a calculator and a partner are valid ways to check.

label: Locate the approved rule, regulation or procedure behind an answer
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
input_specification: The instructor teaches the current approved local information directory and controlled-document retrieval using a harmless fictional institution. Its complete pack contains programme rule P2: workshop registration goes to desk P; simulated regulatory extract R2: the stated eligibility condition must be checked by the assigned programme owner; procedure S2: staff room reservations go to desk S after current availability confirmation. Supply issuer, version, applicability, approval, audience and owner, superseded P1 and an unrelated institution's similarly named passage. The regulatory extract is an invented training case, never legal authority.
definition: Locate the actual approved rule, regulation or procedure relevant to each confirmed public and employee question, retrieve the whole needed passage and check its exact institution, current version, approval, audience and scope. Preserve qualifications, exceptions and the distinction between explaining an approved general condition and deciding a private case or interpreting law. Detect conflicting, missing or unapproved information and obtain a responsible owner response rather than inventing a resolution.

label: Explain supplied corporate information and answer a practical question
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
input_specification: An actual closed role-play uses current approved fictional P2/R2/S2 passages and both employee/public questions. Public Alex asks where and how to start registration, and whether a general eligibility condition means automatic acceptance; employee Robin asks how to begin a room reservation. Supply the complete answer criteria and available spoken, text, picture, sign or AAC-supported exchange, source-reading support and exact next contacts. A question cannot be answered solely by sending an unexplained link.
definition: Explain the relevant approved institutional/corporate rule, simulated regulation and procedure in the person's agreed accessible method, preserving all required conditions and limits. Actually answer each general practical question and state the supported next action: public registration at P and eligibility review by the owner, staff reservation through S with availability confirmation. Ask the enquirer to indicate what the answer means for their next step and clarify any changed interpretation. Do not promise acceptance or a booking from a general explanation.

label: Resolve a misunderstanding and refer an unanswered enquiry
source: Capability Atlas individually authored profession pathways v1
input_specification: The same actual supervised employee/public enquiry exchange includes a misunderstanding that is directly answerable from P2/S2, a qualified programme-owner reply to a general eligibility question and a private decision absent from the general pack. definition: Ask which precise doubt remains, compare it with the approved passage, provide and verify the relevant correction and have the person indicate the revised understood answer/next step. Keep separately resolved, referred, accepted and still-unanswered parts; do not mark all questions solved from a sent ticket.

practice_exercise.label: 4. Change units without changing the quantity

cards.title: Paired-value reference chart
cards.text: Use this chart directly, calculate, or ask a partner to read a matching pair. Volume, mass and length are separate kinds of quantity.
rows: Smaller unit → more units for the same quantity. Do not convert mass to volume without additional information.

questions.prompt: Write 0.75 L in mL.
steps: Find the paired values 0.75 L and 750 mL, or calculate 0.75 × 1000.
Check that the same volume needs a larger number of smaller units.

mistakes.feedback: That moves in the opposite direction. One litre contains 1000 millilitres; look up the paired quantity.

questions.prompt: Write 0.5 kg in g.
steps: Find 0.5 kg = 500 g on the chart, or calculate 0.5 × 1000.
The mass stays the same; only the unit and number change.

questions.prompt: Write 25 cm in mm.
steps: Each centimetre represents 10 millimetres.
25 × 10 = 250 mm. The paired-value chart supplies the same result.

mistakes.feedback: Millimetres are smaller than centimetres. The number of units should increase for the same length.

questions.prompt: New quantity: express 0.2 L in mL. Use the relation 1 L = 1000 mL, a calculator or partner support.
steps: Use the unit relation with the new value rather than copying an earlier pair.
0.2 × 1000 = 200 mL. The represented volume stays the same.
